title: Chippewa Songs
subtitle: from Frances Densmore, Chippewa Music I and II
author: Anonymous (Ojibwe)
note: Song words recorded from Ojibwe (Chippewa) singers in Minnesota and Wisconsin from 1907 to 1910 and printed by Frances Densmore in Chippewa Music (Bureau of American Ethnology Bulletin 45, 1910) and Chippewa Music II (Bulletin 53, 1913), from the Internet Archive scans, proofed against the page images. Each song is given in her English words, followed by the Ojibwe words as she wrote them, with her accent marks. Where she gives a word-by-word gloss the English is the gloss, line for line; where she bracketed several words under one free translation, the free translation stands once. Songs are numbered as in each volume (I. and II.). Only songs whose words she prints are included. Her music, analyses, singer and catalogue notes, narratives, song pictures and prose are left out.
blurb: Songs of the Ojibwe of the Great Lakes (dream songs, war songs, Midewiwin songs, love songs and songs of play), as written down and translated by Frances Densmore.
